issue.title: [sflow]During the de init sequence sometimes hsflow throws error log when it accesses interface after removal

failure.body:
#### Description

This is a statistical issue. Sometimes very rarely during the de initialization sequence sflow accesses the net device after it is removed. We notice the error log as seen below

```
Apr 24 <IPV6>.969346 r-leopard-56 INFO container: docker cmd: wait for syncd
Apr 24 <IPV6>.970278 r-leopard-56 INFO container: docker cmd: stop for syncd
Apr 24 <IPV6>.971268 r-leopard-56 DEBUG container: container_stop: END
Apr 24 <IPV6>.021434 r-leopard-56 NOTICE root: Stopped syncd service...
Apr 24 <IPV6>.251818 r-leopard-56 INFO kernel: [ 4653.759491] sxd_kernel: sx_netdev_cleanup
Apr 24 <IPV6>.898447 r-leopard-56 ERR sflow#hsflowd: device Ethernet0 Get SIOCGIFFLAGS failed : No such device
Apr 24 <IPV6>.919803 r-leopard-56 INFO kernel: [ 4656.426494] sxd_kernel: sx_core_cleanup_module
Apr 24 <IPV6>.919837 r-leopard-56 NOTICE kernel: [ 4656.426516] sxd_kernel: remove a PCI core device
Apr 24 <IPV6>.987789 r-leopard-56 NOTICE kernel: [ 4656.498085] sxd_kernel: sending UDEV event from sx-core driver [bus=<IPV6>.0, action=1 (KOBJ_REMOVE), origin='Unregistering from PCI']
```
#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Enable sflow
2. Reboot the device
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
Error in syslog from hsflowd

#### Describe the results you expected:
No Errors is syslog
